annotations.title: Rebuild up to 3 pages as a free preview

description: Starts the app's free preview: up to 3 pages the owner picks (default: the home page and the two largest pages) are rebuilt from the uploaded app file as React pages on sample data, then checked and scored automatically. Free, once per app. Nothing in the owner's app changes and nothing is charged. It takes a few minutes: call nc_preview_status to follow it. Asking again for the same job returns the build that is already running.

job_id.description: The job_id from nc_connect. The app file must already be uploaded and planned (nc_compile_plan).

pages.description: Names of up to 3 pages, as listed by nc_compile_plan with detail full. Leave out for the default pick.
